text:
Flower of the poppies:

deceive me and do not love me.


How you exaggerate your aroma,

how far you carry your blush,

flower that paints dark circles on yourself

and exhales your soul to the sun!


Flower of the poppies.


One woman resembled you

in the blush with which you deceive,

and also because she had,

like you, black lashes.


Flower of the poppies.

One woman resembled you...

And I tremble only to see

your hand placed in mine:

I tremble lest a day should dawn

when you become a woman!

translation.title: The Threat of the Flower
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the playful refrain and the uneasy transformation from flower to woman.
